title: Perfect generators extend across an affine-open cover
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U be a quasi-compact open subscheme and V an affine open subscheme with X = U union V. If P is a perfect generator of D_QCoh(O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-generators], then there are a perfect object Q of D(O_X) whose restriction to U has P as a direct summand, and a perfect Koszul object K' of D(O_X) supported on the closed subset V minus U, such that Q direct-sum K' is a generator of D_QCoh(O_X).

source.place: Tag 09IS, proof (using Tags 09IQ and 09IR), induction step
